decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission

(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990).

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuildinghereby permitted shall match those used in the main house.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building in particular and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B1.1New Development and H6.4 Extensions and alterations)

Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the rear elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

(Reason.  To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development)

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 9 Firs Drive.

Reason.  The building is considered unsuitable for occupation by a separate person or household not related to the occupiers of the single family dwelling to , and for such use that is not ancillary to that of the main dwelling.  To accord with policy H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations to Housing of the Hounslow UDP)

Condition : 5 - The proposed outbuilding would be acceptable due to its position, size design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, or the neighbours living conditions and complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the The London Borough of Hounslow Adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to be used as a playroom to rear of house
